itemForm.websites.title: Websites
itemForm.websites.hint: Autofill offers this login on every website listed. The rule sets how closely an address must match. Linked MFA codes and backup codes use these websites too.
itemForm.websites.bad: Type a website, like github.com or https://github.com.
itemForm.websites.badRegex: That is not a valid regular expression.
itemForm.generator.title: Strength
itemForm.links.title: Linked items
itemForm.links.unlinkMissing: Unlink an item that is not available
itemForm.links.hint: Link related items, like a login with its MFA code, backup codes and passkey. A link shows on both items.
itemForm.links.failed: Saved. The link could not be written on {names}. Press Save to try again.
itemForm.fields.title: Custom fields
itemForm.fields.none: No custom fields on this item.
itemForm.fields.hint: Pick a field your admin set up, or make your own. Admin fields keep their name and type; you fill in the value.
itemForm.fields.hintAdminOnly: Pick a field your admin set up. Admin fields keep their name and type; you fill in the value.
itemForm.fields.name: Field {n} name
itemForm.fields.nameNeeded: Give the field a name, or clear its value.
itemForm.attachments.title: Attachments
itemForm.attachments.hint: Files you attach to this note are encrypted in this browser before upload.
itemForm.file.quota: Counts toward the attachment space your admin set for you.
itemForm.error.fileTooLarge: That file is larger than this server takes.
itemForm.error.storageExceeded: That file would take you over your attachment space.
itemForm.passkey.title: Passkeys come from websites
itemForm.passkey.body: A passkey is made when a website asks for one, so there is nothing to type here. Sign up or add a passkey on the website, and Kemlock saves it to the vault you pick.
itemForm.passkey.browser: In a browser, use Kemlock for browsers.
itemForm.passkey.phone: On a phone, choose Kemlock as the passkey provider in the system settings.
itemForm.passkey.hint: The passkey's private key is sealed in the vault like everything else; the website only ever sees the public key.
itemForm.website.label: Website
itemForm.website.hint: The websites this is used on, separated by commas.
itemForm.website.fromLogin: From the linked login {name}. Change it there; this updates with it.
itemForm.website.fromItem: From the linked item {name}. Change it there; this updates with it.
itemForm.website.fromItems: From the linked items {names}. Change them there; this updates with them.
itemForm.card.type: Type the number on the card. The brand shows as you type.
itemForm.card.luhn: This number doesn't pass the card check. Look for a mistyped digit.
itemForm.card.validUnknown: Valid card number. The brand is not one Kemlock knows, so none is shown.
itemForm.card.length: That is not a length this card number can have.
itemForm.card.cvc.four: 4 digits, on the front of the card.
itemForm.card.cvc.three: 3 digits, on the back of the card.
itemForm.card.cvc.short: A security code has 3 or 4 digits.
itemForm.card.cvc.mismatch: This security code doesn't have the digits this card uses.
itemForm.contact.armorHint: Paste their armored PGP public key block to encrypt files and messages to them. Leave it empty for a plain contact.
itemForm.contact.armorHintHasKey: This contact has a key. Paste a new key block to replace it, or leave this empty to keep it.
